import re

with open('main.tex', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# 1. Column header: DAF (10 tasks) -> DAF (10 tasks, excl.\ zero-death)
content = content.replace(
    r'\textbf{DAF (10 tasks)} \\',
    r'\textbf{DAF (10 tasks, excl.\ zero-death)} \\'
)

# 2. Qwen CI: 81.4 -> 81.3
content = content.replace(
    r'90.4\% [81.4, 99.1]',
    r'90.4\% [81.3, 99.1]'
)

# 3. Llama 11-task CI: 80.0 -> 80.2
content = content.replace(
    r'88.2\% [80.0, 95.1]',
    r'88.2\% [80.2, 95.1]'
)

# 4. Gemma 11-task CI: [79.5, 98.4] -> [68.8, 100.0]
content = content.replace(
    r'89.7\% [79.5, 98.4]',
    r'89.7\% [68.8, 100.0]'
)

# 5. Llama 10-task CI: 91.5 -> 91.3
content = content.replace(
    r'97.0\% [91.5, 100.0]',
    r'97.0\% [91.3, 100.0]'
)

# 6. Caption update
old_caption = r'''DAF sensitivity analysis. \`\`10 tasks'' excludes \texttt{find-non-living-thing} (the only task type with zero death rate across all models). Episode-level bootstrap 95\% CIs (\$B = 10{,}000\$).'''
new_caption = r'''DAF sensitivity analysis. \`\`10 tasks'' excludes \texttt{find-non-living-thing} (the only task type with zero death rate). Bootstrap 95\% CIs (\$B{=}10{,}000\$, seed 42). Full-sample CIs use cluster bootstrap (\$K{=}11\$); exclusion CIs use episode-level bootstrap over the remaining 10 task types.'''

content = content.replace(old_caption, new_caption)

with open('main.tex', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print('Done')
"
